what_it_is.prose: The Drishti Counter UAV Radar / C-UAS System is a counter-UAS platform developed by Astra Microwave Products Limited (AMPL) of Hyderabad, launched at Aero India 2023 in February 2023. The Atlas slug 'Astra Counter-Drone System' is an editorial designation; the official OEM product name on astramwp.com is 'Drishti Counter UAV Radar' / 'C-UAS System'. The Drishti radar has a 4 km range for 0.001 sq m targets (micro drones) and can track 100+ drones simultaneously. The complete C-UAS system combines active radar, passive RF sensors, and multi-band jamming (including non-kinetic effectors). Astra Microwave was one of four vendors (alongside L&T, Adani Defence, and ECIL) to receive DRDO's Counter-Drone System Transfer of Technology in April 2022. Astra Microwave also has a joint venture with Rafael Comsys Private Limited, which received a ₹255.88 crore MoD order on 13 December 2024. The Drishti C-UAS is a modest part of Astra Microwave's overall business — the company is primarily an RF/microwave subsystems supplier with a record ₹4,300 crore order book (as of August 2026, post the ₹2,205 crore HAL Uttam AESA contract signed 30 July 2026 for the Tejas Mk-1A programme). FY26 consolidated revenue was ₹1,163 crore (+11% YoY). The Atlas slug should ideally be renamed to 'Drishti C-UAS (Astra Microwave)' to match OEM branding.

faq.question: Why is the Atlas slug 'Astra Counter-Drone System' instead of 'Drishti'?
faq.answer: The official OEM product name on astramwp.com is 'Drishti Counter UAV Radar' / 'C-UAS System'. The Atlas slug 'Astra Counter-Drone System' is an editorial designation that should ideally be renamed to 'Drishti C-UAS (Astra Microwave)' to match OEM branding. This is flagged as an open question for Atlas register correction.

faq.question: Is Drishti C-UAS Astra Microwave's main product?
faq.answer: No. The Drishti C-UAS is a modest part of Astra Microwave's overall business. The company is primarily an RF/microwave subsystems supplier with a record ₹4,300 crore order book (as of August 2026), dominated by the ₹2,205 crore HAL Uttam AESA contract signed 30 July 2026 for the Tejas Mk-1A programme. FY26 consolidated revenue was ₹1,163 crore (+11% YoY). Drishti C-UAS-specific revenue is not separately disclosed.

faq.question: Who are the other DRDO Counter-Drone System ToT recipients?
faq.answer: DRDO transferred Counter-Drone System technology to four Indian industry partners in April 2022: Larsen & Toubro (L&T), Astra Microwave, Adani Defence & Aerospace, and Electronics Corporation of India Limited (ECIL). Each vendor produces a variant of the DRDO D4 / IDDIS architecture under the ToT framework. BEL is the prime productioniser of the IDDIS variant (Atlas slug cus-001).
